hero.title: Trusted by Industrial Operators Across the Gulf
hero.subtitle: Tekton supplies genuine OEM parts and equipment to plants in Bahrain and the GCC. One purchase order covers sourcing, freight and delivery to your gate.

platform.title: One Supplier for the Whole Plant
platform.body: Procurement teams often juggle dozens of vendors for electrical spares, hydraulics, filters and lubricants. Tekton consolidates that list. We buy from manufacturers directly, keep the paperwork in order, and land the order at your site with a lead time you can plan around.

trust.title: Genuine Parts, Documented
trust.body: Every item ships with its manufacturer certificate and test reports where they apply. No grey-market stock and no re-labelled substitutes. If a part carries a serial number, you can trace it back to the factory that made it.

statement.title: Built for Plants That Can't Afford to Wait
statement.body: Downtime costs money by the minute. We quote fast, answer the phone, and tell you the real lead time before you commit.

about.title: The Tekton Standard
about.intro: Tekton Global Trading & Services is an industrial supply company based in the Kingdom of Bahrain, serving plants and operators across the GCC.
paragraphs: The company exists to solve a specific problem: plants in the Gulf depend on equipment from manufacturers spread across Europe, Asia and the Americas, and getting the right part here, with the right paperwork, takes longer than it should. We shorten that path.

We buy from manufacturers directly, consolidate freight, clear customs under our own paperwork and deliver to site. Along the way we collect the certificates, test reports and traceability documents that your quality system asks for.

Our customers work in oil and gas, power, water, petrochemicals, aluminium, steel, cement, food processing, railways and mining. What they have in common is that a late or wrong part stops production, so we treat every order like it is holding up a line. Usually, it is.

values.title: Say the real lead time
values.body: An honest six weeks beats a fictional three. Our quotes state the lead time we actually expect, and we flag delays as soon as the factory flags them to us.

values.title: Paperwork is part of the part
values.body: A pressure gauge without its calibration certificate is not finished goods. Documentation ships with the hardware or the order is not complete.

values.title: Answer the phone
values.body: During working hours you reach a person who can look up your order, not a ticket queue.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: This website is operated by Tekton Global Trading & Services (“Tekton”, “we”, “us”), an industrial supplies trading company based in Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain. This policy explains what information we handle when you use this website and how we treat it.

sections.heading: Information you give us
sections.body: The website does not require an account and has no sign-up forms. If you contact us — by email, phone, WhatsApp, or by using the quote-request form (which opens a message in your own email application) — we receive the details you choose to share, such as your name, company, contact details and the content of your enquiry. We use this information only to respond to and fulfil your enquiry.

sections.heading: Information collected automatically
sections.body: Our web server keeps standard technical logs (such as IP address, browser type, pages requested and timestamps) for security and troubleshooting. If we enable website analytics, we use a privacy-focused, self-hosted tool that collects aggregated usage statistics without advertising trackers.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The public website does not set marketing or tracking cookies. A single functional cookie is used only by our own staff to sign in to the content editor; ordinary visitors never receive it.

sections.heading: How we share information
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your information. Enquiry details are shared only within Tekton and, where needed to fulfil a request, with the relevant manufacturer or logistics partner. We may disclose information where required by law.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Enquiry correspondence is kept for as long as needed to handle your request and maintain normal business records, after which it is deleted or archived in line with our record-keeping obligations.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it where we have no continuing business or legal reason to keep it. Contact us using the details on our contact page and we will respond promptly.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Continued use of the website after an update means the revised policy applies.

sections.heading: About these terms
sections.body: These terms govern your use of the Tekton Global Trading & Services website. By using the website you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the website.

sections.heading: Informational content
sections.body: The website presents general information about our products, services and capabilities. Product ranges, specifications and availability change over time, and content is provided “as is” without warranty of completeness or fitness for a particular purpose. Always confirm technical details with us before purchasing.

sections.heading: Quotations and orders
sections.body: Enquiries and quote requests made through the website are invitations to discuss supply and do not create a contract. Prices, lead times and terms of sale are only binding once confirmed by Tekton in a written quotation or order confirmation, which will state the applicable conditions of sale.

sections.heading: Trademarks and third-party brands
sections.body: Manufacturer names, brands and product marks referenced on this website (including SENKO and Munters) belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify genuine products and services we supply or support. No affiliation or endorsement is implied beyond the supply relationships we describe.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Unless otherwise noted, the design, text and imagery on this website belong to Tekton or its licensors. You may view and print pages for your own business evaluation; any other reproduction or reuse requires our written permission.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the website — including attempting to gain unauthorised access, probing or disrupting the service, or using automated tools to scrape content at scale.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Tekton is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website or reliance on its content. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Bahrain, and the courts of Bahrain have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute relating to them.
